name: Solana
executive_summary: Solana's mainnet went live in 2020, built specifically for high-throughput, low-latency execution, and six years later at the time of this scoring that speed shows up in a Real-World Utility score of 92 and a TradFi score of 79. The AI score of 75 reflects genuinely strong fundamentals, with execution, tooling, and developer support all scoring well, but it's held to that number because Solana's fastest, fully guaranteed settlement upgrade was still running on testnet rather than live for everyone at the time of scoring. That's why the gap between the two scores is only 4 points: the AI score already reflects Solana's real strength, held back by that one missing piece rather than any deeper weakness.

key_findings: Quantum Resistance Pass -- Winternitz Vault shipped live January 2025, an outright pass on this gate.
Real-World Utility (92) is SOL's strongest category -- deep, active real-world usage.

Privacy & Confidentiality (50) -- native Token-2022 confidential transfers are live on mainnet with a protocol-level auditor key, an institution-shaped design. Credit is limited because they hide amounts only, leave the transaction graph public, are opt-in twice over, and do not cover native SOL.

Decentralization (52) is a standing watch item -- Nakamoto Coefficient has declined from 31 to roughly 19-20, and the August 12, 2026 Teraswitch routing fault exposed a hosting-concentration dimension this category does not currently measure.
Raw 78.54 sits a full point below the Institutional Grade floor with no rounding margin.

binding_cap.short_note: Capped by Deterministic Finality Partial -- Alpenglow deterministic finality upgrade is testnet-only as of scoring.

key_findings: Raw AI fundamentals (78.0) reflect strong execution and tooling depth, held back mainly by the finality gate.
Bound by the Deterministic Finality gate rather than Operational Reliability or Programmability Tier.
Agent Tooling (90) is SOL's strongest AI category -- deep SDK, simulation, and agent-native infrastructure.

watch_items: Alpenglow (sub-200ms deterministic finality) targeted mainnet late Q3/early Q4 2026 -- would lift the Deterministic Finality Partial cap entirely once live.
Decentralization trend (validator count and Nakamoto Coefficient decline) -- watch for further downward revision.

The August 12, 2026 Teraswitch routing fault took roughly 29% of staked SOL offline for 33 minutes and brought the network to about 86% of a finality-halt threshold, with the status page recording no incident. Security & Future-Proofing (80) is a re-score candidate on this event.
